Inspect Fit Computation and Curvature Diagnostics

Source: R/huncertainty.R
fit_diagnostics.Rd

Return the recorded calculation methods and final Hessian checks from hfit().

Usage

fit_diagnostics(fit)

Arguments

fit

A result from hfit().

Value

A list with recorded methods in computation, calculation status, reason, free parameters, scale, and, when available, difference-step checks, curvature changes, recalculated score, scaled condition number, and Newton decrement.

Details

computation records the engine, optimizer gradient source and stored final Hessian source without re-evaluating the model. Its engine list contains requested, used and fallback_reason. used lists engines actually invoked in first-use order, including any partial C++ pass before fallback. It can contain both "cpp" and "r". A custom likelihood uses "custom" and has no requested built-in engine. Recording includes final curvature evaluations.

computation$gradient$used is "numeric", "analytic", "user" or "attribute". It describes the returned optimizer score, separately from a recalculated score in stable curvature checks. computation$hessian$used is "maxLik_numeric", "scaled_central_Richardson", "user", "attribute", "BHHH", "disabled" or "unavailable". The Hessian list also retains the requested final_hessian choice and any finalHessian override. Its reason explains a skipped stabilization or unavailable result. If both a derivative function and likelihood derivative attributes were supplied, the source is NA with a reason because precedence depends on maxLik.

The saved record is a snapshot; later objective evaluations or option changes do not update it. Older fits with model metadata but no computation record return recorded = FALSE and NA for unrecorded methods. Any previously saved gradient selection is retained. Their engine is not inferred from current options.

status = "ok" means the numerical curvature checks passed, not that the optimizer found a global maximum or that Wald intervals have correct coverage. The numerical calculation checks information and standard-error stability across steps. The stored optimizer gradient and coefficients are not changed. A Newton decrement above 0.1 triggers a score warning. Its square divided by two estimates the local quadratic improvement in log-likelihood. An information condition number above 1e8 triggers a weak-curvature warning; eigenvalues at or below 1e-10 times the largest absolute eigenvalue do not support numerical inversion. These thresholds are numerical diagnostics. With the default final_hessian = "maxLik", these additional checks are not performed and the status is "not_checked". Request final_hessian = "stable" to run them. Earlier fits without these checks also have status "not_checked".

See also

hfit(), fitted_hspec()

Examples

h <- new("hspec", mu = .3, alpha = 0, beta = 1)
fit <- hfit(h, c(0, .2, .3, .5, 1), lambda_component0 = 0,
            fixed = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE), final_hessian = "stable")
fit_diagnostics(fit)$status
#> [1] "ok"
fit_diagnostics(fit)$computation
#> $recorded
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $engine
#> $engine$requested
#> [1] "auto"
#> 
#> $engine$used
#> [1] "cpp"
#> 
#> $engine$fallback_reason
#> NULL
#> 
#> 
#> $gradient
#> $gradient$requested
#> [1] "numeric"
#> 
#> $gradient$used
#> [1] "numeric"
#> 
#> $gradient$reason
#> NULL
#> 
#> 
#> $hessian
#> $hessian$requested
#> [1] "stable"
#> 
#> $hessian$finalHessian
#> NULL
#> 
#> $hessian$used
#> [1] "scaled_central_Richardson"
#> 
#> $hessian$reason
#> NULL
